name: Ragnir
notes: Giant squirrel, Ratatoskr fruit, Hammer of the War God, ancient traitor to Imu, fought with original Joy Boy/Nika
title: Ancient Threat
bio: An ancient being whose existence predates the current world order — confirmed as a giant squirrel, roughly the scale of Luffy in his current giant Gear Fifth form. Wields the Risu Risu no Mi, Model: Ratatoskr. Title: The Hammer — herald of the War God, historically fought alongside the original Joy Boy and Nika. Imu names him a traitor.
events: Ch.1181 leaker spoilers (unverified) imply Ragnir is being framed alongside Luffy and Loki as the arc's monster trio — three figures whose combined presence defines the ceiling of current active power in Elbaf. Stock has been climbing on ancient-lore speculation since Elbaf began. The monster trio framing, if confirmed, would mark the first time an ancient being has been placed in direct peer comparison with a sitting Emperor and the Prince of Elbaf. Priced ahead of confirmation.

name: Biblo
notes: Owl of the Elbaf Owl Library; knew of a secret room Saul did not; independently saved all the books
title: Guardian of the Owl Library
bio: The owl of the Owl Library at Elbaf — and its most quietly capable guardian. Biblo possessed knowledge of a secret underground room that even Jaguar D. Saul, the library's keeper, did not know existed. When danger came, Biblo acted independently and moved the entire collection before anyone thought to ask.
events: Ch.1182: revealed to have moved all books to a secret underground room before the God Knights reached the library — a room Saul was unaware of. Saul is grateful but openly puzzled why Biblo never mentioned it. Minor scene, but establishes independent judgment and deeper institutional knowledge than the library's official keeper.
